name: World War I Fishbone Diagram
description:
Create a Cause-and-Effect (Fishbone) diagram for the causes of World War I in ActivInspire.

Task Requirements:
1. Create a new flipchart or use the blank page.
2. Draw the diagram structure using the Shape/Line tools:
   - A central horizontal line (the spine).
   - A shape (circle/triangle/box) at the end for the 'Head' labeled 'WWI'.
   - At least 4 branching lines (ribs) coming off the spine.
3. Label the four branches with the M.A.I.N. causes using the Text tool:
   - Militarism
   - Alliances
   - Imperialism
   - Nationalism
4. Add a title 'Causes of World War I' at the top.
5. Save the flipchart to '/home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/ww1_fishbone.flipchart'.
